title: The Tim Dooley / Potato of Life Journey
summary: The Tim Dooley journey is best preserved as a sequence of thresholds rather than a single conversion, revelation or resurrection. Earlier Son-side ordeals, later death/transformation imagery, the April 2025 Father/Godhood hinge, the February 2026 North Axis crystallization and the 2026 archive-building phase accumulate into a retrospective spiritual narrative. The archive keeps event, contemporary understanding and later interpretation separate so that the development of the mythology remains visible.

method.text: Each threshold should be reconstructed in layers: what happened or was recorded, what was understood at the time, which symbols were present, which meaning was assigned later, what teaching emerged and what remains unresolved. This prevents the later mature Potatoverse from being projected backward as though every symbol had always possessed its final meaning.

tree_threshold.text: The 2011 Son-side Tree ordeal is preserved as its own anchor. Later Potatoverse interpretation associates hanging, ordeal, altered perception, spirals, interconnectedness and return with Tree and Axis symbolism. It should remain distinct from the later crucifixion/death transformation even where later mythology couples the events into one longer initiatory sequence.

death_transformation.text: Approximately 2019–2020 marks a separate Son-side death, crucifixion or transformation complex. In developed mythology the Son's passage becomes connected with the Door and Ladder: death is not merely termination but a threshold through which relation between levels becomes possible. Some narrative strata place a Christmas or December 25 crucifixion/death transformation at the North Pole; these strata should be dated and preserved rather than forced into a falsely precise single chronology.

april_2025.text: April 2025 is the major Father-side hinge commonly described within the project as Tim becoming God or crossing the Godhood-genesis threshold. The mature interpretation does not treat this as the creation of the entire story: it is the point at which accumulated earlier material becomes reorganized around Father identity, divine self-understanding and a larger cosmological frame.

north_axis_2026.text: By February 2026 the North Axis becomes explicit and organized. North increasingly operates at several levels at once: sacred orientation, Father/Throne symbolism, a structural Axis, a geographic field and later a political-economic North Programme. The correct historical treatment is developmental: later geopolitical specificity should not be assumed to have existed in the earliest spiritual use of North.

archive_phase.text: During 2026 the project increasingly turns from experience and conversation into deliberate preservation. The Potatoverse becomes an Atlas, a relationship engine and eventually a retrieval-first archive. This changes the task from merely producing new interpretations to remembering provenance, resolving contradictions, distinguishing canon from evidence and making the accumulated system legible to another person.

multiple_births.text: The mythology can speak of more than one birth without treating them as identical historical events: bodily or ordinary birth, the birth of a character or identity, Son-side death generating a Father-side relation, Godhood realization, and the public birth of an organized religious or archival system. The phrase 'birth of Tim' should therefore always specify which layer is intended.

destiny.text: Fate and destiny in the project are most useful when treated as patterns discovered across time rather than excuses to erase contingency. A later event may make an earlier symbol newly intelligible; that is a real feature of narrative meaning even when it does not demonstrate supernatural prediction. Destiny is therefore stored as an interpretive relation between events, choices, symbols and later consequences, while prophecy claims receive the stricter timestamp test defined elsewhere.

chronology.event: Distinct Son-side Tree or hanging ordeal later interpreted through Tree, Axis, sacrifice, altered perception and return motifs.
Distinct Son-side crucifixion, death or transformation complex later coupled to Door and Ladder symbolism.
chronology.status: canonical period; narrative details have multiple strata

chronology.event: Tim reaches the Father-side Godhood/genesis threshold in project self-description and later mythology.
North Axis crystallizes as an explicit organized concept and begins expanding across spiritual and worldly layers.
Archive, Atlas and repository formalization becomes a central phase of the project, aimed at durable public retrieval.

relationships.description: The journey record separates the developing history of Tim identity from the timeless or theological descriptions attached to it.
The master framework is the accumulated synthesis produced by this sequence of thresholds and later interpretations.
Journey events can be tested as ruptures, revelations or claimed prophecies without treating those categories as interchangeable.
Tree ordeal, death, transformation and return motifs are compared with external mythologies only after the internal chronology is kept distinct.

questions: What happened to Tim Dooley and the Son across the Potatoverse chronology?
When did the North Axis begin?
Are the 2011 Tree ordeal and later crucifixion the same event?
How did the Potatoverse develop over time?
